description: Java entity class representing a Payment within the domain model of the project, including its fields and accessors.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Entity class representing a payment made to a contractor associated with a project, including payment details and relationships.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the payment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the payment.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Project.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project with this payment.

methods.name: getContract
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Contract.

methods.name: setContract
methods.description: Associates a Contract with this payment.

methods.name: getMilestone
methods.description: Retrieves the associated Milestone.

methods.name: setMilestone
methods.description: Associates a Milestone with this payment.

methods.name: getContractor
methods.description: Retrieves the Contractor to whom the payment is made.

methods.name: setContractor
methods.description: Associates a Contractor with this payment.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the payment was made.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of payment.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the amount paid.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount paid.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the payment (PENDING, APPROVED, etc.).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the payment.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the method of payment.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the method of payment.

methods.name: getReferenceNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the reference number for the payment.

methods.name: setReferenceNumber
methods.description: Sets the reference number for the payment.
